name.value: Ageas Federal Life Insurance Linked Accident Care Rider

linked_or_non_linked.value: linked-base, non-participating, individual pure risk premium life insurance rider; level rider premium
linked_or_non_linked.quote: Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Premium, Life Insurance Rider

attached_to_ulips.note: Named by 4 of the 6 Ageas ULIPs. The brochure says it attaches to unit-linked non-participating individual products.

waiver_of_premium.quote: One out of the following two Rider Options can be selected by Policyholder:
waiver_of_premium.note: Two options only: accidental death benefit, or comprehensive benefit (accidental death, accidental total and permanent disability and related accident benefits).

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.quote: One out of the following two Rider Options can be selected by Policyholder:
waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.note: Two options only: accidental death benefit, or comprehensive benefit (accidental death, accidental total and permanent disability and related accident benefits).

critical_illness.note: Two options only: accidental death benefit, or comprehensive benefit (accidental death, accidental total and permanent disability and related accident benefits).

accidental_death.value: Accidental death benefit option: the rider sum assured as a lump sum. 2X benefit (200%) on death in an airplane or train accident. Comprehensive option adds transport of mortal remains (1%, up to Rs 50,000) and family travel for NRIs (2%, up to Rs 1,00,000).
accidental_death.quote: benefit equal to Rider Sum Assured shall be

accidental_disability.value: Comprehensive option: accidental total and permanent disability pays 100% of rider sum assured, plus monthly income of 1% for 12 months (cap Rs 6,00,000), plus lifestyle support for rehabilitation (10%, cap Rs 10,00,000).

term_cover.quote: One out of the following two Rider Options can be selected by Policyholder:
term_cover.note: Two options only: accidental death benefit, or comprehensive benefit (accidental death, accidental total and permanent disability and related accident benefits).

hospital_cash.quote: One out of the following two Rider Options can be selected by Policyholder:
hospital_cash.note: Two options only: accidental death benefit, or comprehensive benefit (accidental death, accidental total and permanent disability and related accident benefits).

other.value: Events must happen within 180 days of the accident.

rider_term.value: Minimum: single pay 1 month, limited pay 60 months, regular pay 12 months. Maximum: 480 months for accidental death, 360 months for comprehensive. Not beyond the base policy term.

premium_paying_rules.value: Single, limited (36 to 240 months) or regular pay. Modes: single, yearly, half-yearly, monthly. Can be added at inception or any policy anniversary during the base premium payment term.

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 5,000. Maximum 150% of the base sum assured for the accidental death option, 100% for the comprehensive option.
sum_assured_limits.quote: Accidental Death Benefit: 150% of Base Sum Assured

premium_deduction.value: Level rider premium payable in addition to the base premium. Not deducted from the fund.
